text:
maria (support): Heads-up — customer Acme encountering a mass reauth loop after our IdP pushed a cert rotation this morning. Users see repeated MFA prompts every 5-10s, sessions keep dropping. Opening thread for eng/SRE help.

maria (support): Repro notes from customer: login succeeds, then right after redirect back to app they get a 302 to /reauth and a new set-cookie for `rdw_device_trust` with a different domain attribute. Clearing cookies sometimes fixes for a single user, but others keep looping.

maria (support): Curl from their webapp repro: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://auth.redwood.test/authorize \n  -H 'Host: app.acme.co' \n  -H 'Cookie: rdw_session=xxx; rdw_device_trust=oldjwt' \n  --data 'client_id=acme&redirect_uri=https://app.acme.co/cb'
```
They see `Set-Cookie: rdw_device_trust=newjwt; Domain=.redwood.test; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None` but their app expects Domain=.acme.co.

tim (eng): @maria thx, tagging. Can you paste the full Set-Cookie header the customer reported? Also which IdP (Okta/Azure)?

maria (support): Customer says Okta rotated certs at 09:12 UTC. Header captured: `Set-Cookie: rdw_device_trust=eyJhb...; Domain=.redwood.test; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None; Max-Age=1209600`

jess (sre): If Domain is .redwood.test but the app domain is .acme.co the browser will drop it. But that alone wouldn't cause reauth loop unless our reauth flow depends on device cookie being present and we then force re-request of SSO which returns new cookie for different domain. Could be a proxy rewrite or manifest bug during the IdP cert roll.

kim (product): We pushed a small change to the private deployment resolver last week that uses canonical issuer host for cookie domain when idp.issuer differs from client host. Might be related.

tim (eng): Steps I'll try: 1) Check token->device-jwt issuance code path for domain selection; 2) Search for recent PRs touching cookie domain logic; 3) Review edge-proxy rewrites (fastly/nginx) that could swap host header.

maria (support): Customer also shared browser console network: after /cb it POSTs to /session/verify -> 401 -> redirect /reauth. The 401 response body: `{"error":"device_trust_missing","action":"reauth"}`

session-bot: [incident] Created incident INC-2026-105: sso-idp-cookie-domain-mismatch — Sev2 — assigned to eng-runtime.

jess (sre): Can we confirm whether the device JWT signature still verifies after rotation? If the IdP rotation changed our verification chain and we treat device JWT as invalid, we'd drop session and force new device assertion — but that should set a cookie on correct domain.

tim (eng): Quick grep shows env var COOKIE_DOMAIN_RESOLUTION=issuer_host is set in the private deployment template. That can override client-specified domain. PR 4021 changed fallback behavior. Reverting might avoid mismatch.

maria (support): Customer says their apps run behind a CNAME that points to 3rd-party CDN which terminates TLS. Host header arriving at Redwood may be the CDN origin `redwood.test` rather than `app.acme.co`. If we infer domain from host header, we could be issuing cookie for the CDN domain.

jess (sre): Good catch — CDN origin header rewrite would explain Domain=.redwood.test. We need to prefer client.redirect_uri host when present.

tim (eng): I'll patch the resolver to prioritize redirect_uri host and fall back to explicit client domain. Rolling a canary to staging now. Patch: `cookie_domain = parseHost(redirect_uri) || client.host || issuer.host`

maria (support): Customer asked for mitigation while we patch. Any suggestions? They can't reconfigure CDN quickly.

jess (sre): Short-term: we can issue a Set-Cookie with Domain unset (host-only) when redirect_uri host differs from origin to avoid leaking to CDN domain. But that requires runtime flip — we can gate behind feature flag `cookie-host-only-heuristic`.

tim (eng): Will prepare a hotfix branch + feature flag. If customer needs immediate unblock, support can suggest a browser workaround: manually clear cookies before login, or access the app via the origin hostname (if available).

maria (support): I'll relay that. Also asked if rotating sessions via server-side call to our session revoke endpoint would re-establish device_jwt properly.

jess (sre): If the cookie was set for wrong domain, revoke won't delete the cookie in browser. Server-side revoke helps only for tokens stored server-side. So not helpful.

tim (eng): Rolling canary now — staging logs: when redirect_uri host is `app.acme.co` cookie domain resolved to `app.acme.co`. Canary passes basic flows. ETA for prod rollback + feature flag: ~40m.

maria (support): Customer grateful, wants ETA. I've given them 1h. Will call back in 30m.

kim (product): Postmortem note: schedule a config audit for private deployments to ensure COOKIE_DOMAIN_RESOLUTION default isn't issuer_host. Also add unit tests for redirect_uri precedence.

jess (sre): After patch, monitor reauth 5xx/401 spikes and device-trust cookie set frequency per client. Set alert if >5% of logins hit device_trust_missing.

tim (eng): Prod patch applied and feature flag on for acme tenant. They report successful login and no loop. Closing loop after 30m stable.

maria (support): Confirmed with customer: working. They did one clear-cookies step before retry but then everything stayed stable. Marking resolved on our side, will file follow-up tasks. :white_check_mark:

maria (support): Follow-ups: #1 revert the issuer_host default in next infra release; #2 add redirect_uri host unit tests; #3 update troubleshooting playbook to mention CDN origin header caveat.

kim (product): Adding to roadmap and assigning.

session-bot: [incident] INC-2026-105 transitioned to resolved by tim (eng).

maria (support): Thanks all — great quick turnaround.
